evidence.title: CVForge — Free AI Resume Builder (No Sign-up, PDF Download)

name: CVForge
summary: Free AI resume builder with live preview, ATS checker, cover letter generator and PDF export; no sign-up.
description: Browser resume builder: dump experience as rough notes and the AI rewrites them into verb-led bullets and a summary while a live preview shows the page. It includes three single-column ATS-friendly templates, an ATS checker that scores a resume against a job ad, a cover letter generator, guides, and a PDF exported through the print dialog as selectable text; drafts are stored only in the browser.
contains: free: no account, watermark or paywall
AI rewrites notes into bullets; you approve every line
ATS checker scores a resume against a job ad
text-based PDF via the browser print dialog
